note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 (independent judge, authored none of spec-rfc4301-architecture-gaps). Section 4.2: "Note: A compliant implementation MUST NOT allow instantiation of an ESP SA that employs both NULL encryption and no integrity algorithm." The stale producer dataplane/xfrm_linux.go::xfrmStateFromParams gained four things: the selector now carries SrcPortMask and DstPortMask, XFRM_STATE_ICMP is set on an inbound SA asked for the RFC 4301 Section 6.2 check (refused on an outbound one), and xfrmNoPMTUDisc and xfrmDontEncapDSCP set NoPMTUDisc and DontEncapDSCP or refuse an outer-header treatment the kernel cannot write. None touches planStateAlgos, the encryption or the integrity fields, and each addition is either a flag or a further refusal, so no path to an ESP SA with NULL encryption and no integrity opened. The tagged units are unchanged; DFCopy and OuterDSCPCopy are the zero values and outerHeaderTreatmentError passes them for every SA shape, so the NULL+sha256 positive still builds. Judgement stands. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-11-10 (independent closure auditor, spec-ipsec-esp-offer-requires-esn) after affa3d8684 and da3ff616f6. crypto/proposal.go::espProposalComplete changed only its doc comment (it now names MandatoryTransformTypesESP); no statement changed. engine/responder.go::espProposalMatches gained one refusal, usableTypes&MandatoryTransformTypesESP() != mandatory -> false, and kept its ESN value check under the len(esns) > 0 conjunct. A further refusal cannot open a path to an ESP SA with NULL encryption and no integrity: the non-AEAD branch still requires the configured integID among the offered INTEG transforms. Tagged units unchanged; judgement stands. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-11-09 (child 20 closure) after the doc comment of dataplane/xfrm_linux.go::xfrmStateFromParams was corrected: it now says the builder sets no XFRM_STATE_NOECN and that ESN and AFUnspec are netlink.XfrmState's only flag fields. No statement of the function changed, so the judgement below stands. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 0db8414cfd and c8e036be19 changed dataplane/xfrm_linux.go::xfrmStateFromParams: the only change sets state.AFUnspec for a tunnel-mode SA with no selector (XFRM_STATE_AF_UNSPEC, RFC 4301 Section 5.1.2 cross-family). No algorithm, key or integrity field changed, so no path to an ESP SA with NULL encryption and no integrity opened. Tagged units unchanged; records current. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after d64411a639 and 08bfef9ee7). Section 4.2: "Note: A compliant implementation MUST NOT allow instantiation of an ESP SA that employs both NULL encryption and no integrity algorithm." d64411a639 makes NULL encryption reachable for IKE Child SAs, so every instantiation path was re-read for NULL + no integrity. Config: parseESPProposal requires a hash for every non-AEAD cipher and null is non-AEAD (TestIntegrityOnlyESPConfig, 'hash is required'). Negotiation: initiator NegotiateESP runs espProposalComplete, which now refuses ENCR_NULL beside AUTH_NONE (RFC 4303 Section 3.2 quoted above it; TestIntegrityOnlyESPRefusals asserts ErrProposalIncomplete); responder matchOfferedESP passes a non-zero integID for a non-AEAD local proposal and espProposalMatches requires the offer to contain it. XFRM: planStateAlgos gives non-AEAD ESP Crypt+Auth and xfrmAuthNames holds no '' or 'none', so TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused (refused, no state) and the NULL+sha256 positive stand. VPP: vppCryptoAlg now names null as CRYPTO_ALG_NONE, so the refusal moved to vppIntegAlg, whose default arm refuses '' and 'none' beside a non-AEAD cipher; the changed TestRFC4301VPPESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused keeps the control install (1 message) and asserts ErrNotSupported with zero VPP messages for '' and 'none'. Dropped from it: the null+sha256 refusal case and the vppCryptoAlg('null') error assertion, both of which asserted behaviour RFC 4303 Section 1 now requires to be absent; that is a correction, not a weakening (owner-approval debt row for 08bfef9ee7 is open). OSPF manual SAs unchanged (validateIPsecInterface both polarities). All units pass at HEAD with and without -tags ze_vpp. Finding, no verdict change: the new VPP negative record breaks vppIntegAlg with a panic, which would also redden the control install, so it shows the unit reaches vppIntegAlg rather than that the default arm is the refusal; a record making vppIntegAlg return INTEG_ALG_NONE for '' would discriminate the refusal itself.
